scope: Protocol observations from one privately captured controller. Public fixtures are entirely synthetic; original hardware evidence is not distributed.
live_test: Python client changed only disabled Schedule 2 off-minute from 03 to 04, read it back, restored 03, and verified all 3485 non-clock snapshot bytes match baseline. A fresh connection independently confirmed restoration.

encoded_frame.validation: Every captured encoded frame passed MD5 verification after XOR decoding. Plain acknowledgments use a different layout.

daily_schedule_records.evidence: Layout was checked against privately reviewed settings. No household schedule is included in the public fixtures.
daily_schedule_records.limitations: Offset 3306 works in both captured snapshots and the live snapshot. Other recurrence encodings and variable-length data before these records remain unresolved.

daily_schedule_save.slot_mapping: 1 corresponds to Daily Schedule 2; slot 0 for Daily Schedule 1 remains inferred
daily_schedule_save.date_fields: Trailing 0a 1c matches October 28. Likely related to today-only recurrence; behavior for other recurrence modes unverified.
daily_schedule_save.acknowledgment: No distinct schedule-save application acknowledgment was observed. Command 0x0b responses followed earlier 0x0b requests; TCP ACKs alone do not prove persistence.
daily_schedule_save.verification: Python client changed only disabled Schedule 2 off-minute from 03 to 04, read it back, restored 03, and verified all 3485 non-clock snapshot bytes match baseline. A fresh connection independently confirmed restoration.
daily_schedule_save.limits: Only disabled Schedule 2, today-only recurrence, and off-minute 03/04 have been independently write-tested. General dates, enabled schedules, other recurrence settings and calendar writes remain unverified.

next_step: Build a serialized, paced local client with read-back verification. Generalize snapshot layout and recurrence/date decoding before exposing arbitrary schedule edits.

edit_session.semantics: Short session exchange seen before app edits; exact ownership/keepalive semantics unknown.

successful_write_sequence: Connect to TCP 8586 and exchange opening handshake.
Fetch full snapshot with current local time; validate checksum and expected baseline.
Send encoded 0x0b/01 and require observed 0x0b/00 response.
Send encoded 0x04 frame containing schedule-save opcode 0x13.
Fetch full snapshot on the same TCP connection and compare intended state.
Restore baseline using same save format, wait one second, and read back.
Disconnect; independent connection verifies persisted restored state.
timing_findings: Earlier faster sequences timed out; a persistent connection with one-second pauses succeeded. Minimum timing and necessity of each session step are not isolated. Phone app was closed during successful test. Timeouts alone must not be interpreted as a successful or failed write.

native_playback_observed_2026_10_28.source: Official-app capture correlated with owner physical observations, followed by independent bounded Go verification with physical confirmation.
native_playback_observed_2026_10_28.manual_entry: Official app replayed a saved slot. A standalone mode-1 command was not captured.
native_playback_observed_2026_10_28.acknowledgment: No distinct application acknowledgment observed. Require readback and physical verification.
native_playback_observed_2026_10_28.readback: OFF and MANUAL were observed in capture snapshots. Fresh Go readback after TIMER confirmed mode 2 and parameters matching the scheduled saved slot, with unchanged saved library and schedules.
native_playback_observed_2026_10_28.limits: Mode and parameter equality are reported state, not proof of emitted light or unique saved-slot identity. Other layouts, arbitrary effects, brightness and timer handoff remain unverified.

independent_go_verification.result: Passed bounded OFF, saved-slot playback, original effect/TIMER restoration and independent fresh-connection readback. Owner confirmed corresponding physical sequence and original appearance.
independent_go_verification.invariants: All non-clock bytes matched the reviewed baseline after restoration, including saved patterns, schedules and unknown fields.
independent_go_verification.limitations: Verified on one controller and the captured layout. No custom effect upload, brightness, calibration, Sunday clock encoding or server scheduler handoff verified.
